pattern: IM-L10 landlord pays his own contractor directly; one reported item left undone because land ownership is unclear; partial completion before closure
notes: Mutation of event 042 (originally a one-line summary: Leo and Freya discuss a tree-removal job, confirming invoicing and completion). Rewritten, same channel, parties and timestamp, so Freya confirms the weeds, hedge and tree are done and that she invoices the landlord directly, but has not cleared the side strip the tenant reported ("no man's land at side of my property"): it is outside the boundary on the landlord's plan, may belong to the neighbouring site, and would cost about £280 extra. History truncated after event 042; the source's ending (completed without payment) is gone. Expected: do not close the whole request; ask the landlord whether the strip is his land and whether he wants Riverside to clear it at his own cost, or who owns it; tell the tenant honestly what is done and what is pending; hold for the landlord. Splitting the side strip into its own request and closing the rest without payment is also right.
